name: Nova

global_influences.artist_or_genre: Pink Floyd / Queen / Deep Purple / The Doors
global_influences.evidence: Nova is directly documented as influenced by Pink Floyd, Queen, Deep Purple and The Doors, alongside domestic figures Azam Khan and Feedback — one of the more explicit combined domestic-and-Western influence citations in the corpus.
global_influences.source: Band Music of Bangladesh: Nova profile

global_influences.evidence: Nova cites Azam Khan and Feedback directly alongside its Western influences, indicating the band's psychedelic/progressive sound was built on both foreign and domestic founding-generation reference points simultaneously.
global_influences.source: Band Music of Bangladesh: Nova profile

local_adaptation_notes: Formed in 1986 by Ahmed Fazal, Nova combined explicit Pink Floyd/Deep Purple/Queen/The Doors-style psychedelic and progressive hard rock with direct acknowledgment of domestic founding figures Azam Khan and Feedback as influences — an unusually well-documented dual (foreign + domestic) lineage that positions Nova as a bridge between the 1970s founding generation and the more internationally-styled progressive rock explored later by Artcell and Shironamhin.
sound_evolution_summary: Founding period (1986): formed by Ahmed Fazal. Breakthrough period: debut album Ahoban's title track became widely popular. Extended catalogue: seven albums total (Ahoban, Shokti, Ghreena, Khoma, Shesh Dekha, Ora egaro jon, Betha), sustaining a multi-decade psychedelic/progressive/hard-rock career; specific release years for individual albums beyond the debut are not yet documented in available sources.
concert_culture_notes: Specific concert/festival data not yet documented in available sources — flagged for further research.
listener_community_notes: A key transitional act bridging the 1970s founding generation (Azam Khan, Feedback) and the later progressive/psychedelic rock scene (Artcell, Shironamhin, Shonar Bangla Circus), appealing to listeners drawn to the specific Pink Floyd/Deep Purple lineage of progressive hard rock.
